definitions.explanation: a written note to help remember something or record information
a formal but non-binding agreement between parties outlining terms and conditions

notes:
{覚書|おぼえがき} has two main uses: personal notes/memos and formal memoranda of understanding.

WRITING:
- ⟦{覚|おぼ}える→覚える：00739_oboeru⟧ (to remember, memorize)
- {書|が}き (writing)

SENSE 1 - PERSONAL NOTES:
- Used for informal notes to oneself
- Similar to ⟦メモ→メモ：00274_memo⟧ but slightly more formal

SENSE 2 - BUSINESS/LEGAL MOU:
- Less binding than a formal contract
- Used to record preliminary agreements
- Common in international business and diplomacy

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {覚書|おぼえがき}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{交|か}わす→交わす：19373_kawasu⟧ (to exchange memoranda)
- {覚書|おぼえがき}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{締結|ていけつ}→締結：13870_teiketsu⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ (to conclude an MOU)
- {覚書|おぼえがき}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{署名|しょめい}する→署名する：22432_shomeisuru⟧ (to sign an MOU)

RELATED WORDS:
- ⟦メモ→メモ：00274_memo⟧ (memo - informal)
- ⟦{契約書|けいやくしょ}→契約書：06416_keiyakusho⟧ (contract - more binding)
- ⟦{合意書|ごういしょ}→合意書：23071_gouisho⟧ (agreement document)
